entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I have my order number right here.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide me with that order number?
It's VF886-012. Look, I don't have time for a big song and dance. I want to return it. It's that simple.

I've pulled up your order, thank you. I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th. Just to make sure I'm routing you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? The issue is that I want my money back! I just changed my mind, okay? It was an impulse buy, I thought I'd be using it all the time, but I don't use it. At all. Are you going to process this or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand completely, and there's no need for a manager. I just need to check the return eligibility for you. One moment while I review the policy on your account.
This is ridiculous. It's barely been a month. If you don't give me my refund, I'll make sure every review site knows how VeloFit treats its customers. This is unacceptable.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed everything here. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file.
Oh. So... you're approving it? Just like that?

Yes, of course. You're within the policy timeframe. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Oh, well, that's... that's great then. Sorry for getting heated. I just expected a fight. Thank you, Alex. That's all I needed.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
